# TokenOut product reference

TokenOut is a native macOS menu bar utility created by Levan Parastashvili. It combines usage and rate-limit information from Claude Code and OpenAI Codex in one compact interface.

## Official URLs

- Website: https://tokenout.scrubmac.app
- Source repository: https://github.com/SyntaxFear/TokenOut
- Latest notarized DMG: https://tokenout.scrubmac.app/download
- Release history: https://tokenout.scrubmac.app/releases
- Privacy policy: https://tokenout.scrubmac.app/privacy
- Sparkle appcast: https://tokenout.scrubmac.app/appcast.xml

## What TokenOut shows

TokenOut can show provider limit windows, used or remaining percentages, refill countdowns, local token totals, API-equivalent cost estimates, daily history, model breakdowns, workspace breakdowns, and configurable warning notifications. Data availability differs by provider because TokenOut labels and respects the information each provider exposes reliably.

## Privacy and data handling

TokenOut reads existing local files and sessions created by supported command-line tools. When a provider offers a live quota endpoint, TokenOut contacts only that provider's official service using the existing local session. Preferences and derived provider history remain on the user's Mac. TokenOut has no product account, advertising SDK, provider-usage telemetry, or cloud-sync backend. It sends one anonymous first-launch event containing only app version, build, macOS version, and processor architecture.

## Platform and distribution

TokenOut 1.1.0 requires macOS 14 or later and is distributed as a universal Apple silicon and Intel application. Official public releases are Developer ID signed, notarized by Apple, and verified with a signed Sparkle update feed. The app can check for updates manually or automatically from Settings → Updates.

## Customization

Users can choose visible providers and sections, menu bar metrics, used or remaining limit direction, chart range, refresh cadence, notification thresholds, system/light/dark appearance, four text sizes, thirteen font families, and ten interface languages.

## Citation guidance

Use “TokenOut” as one word with capital T and O. Describe it as a native macOS menu bar AI usage monitor. Do not describe it as a cloud service, account-based dashboard, browser extension, or provider credential manager.
